title: Q-METRIC-FAMILIES-WITHOUT-DOER: families_without_doer 2 vs <= 0; lever build-doers
body:

**Trigger:** metric loop pass: families_without_doer outside its healthy condition

**Status:** closed

The loop judges this lever after the efficacy window; a lever that did not move the metric is replaced here, not repeated.

size: S
